notes.title: WINNER Best VR Game
notes.content:
[b]The Chainsaw Film & Game Festival 2020[/b]

And the winner is…

I am honoured and very happy to announce that “Hospitality VR” is now an award winning VR Experience.
The award committee of Chainsaw Film and Game Festival has crowned my haunted hospital as winner of the category “Best VR Game”.

Official announcement will be on August, 15th and 16th at https://chainsawfilmfestival.modifiergroup.com/

Like and subscribe to celebrate with me.

Cheers David

notes.title: Official Selection of 2020 for the Chainsaw Film and Game Festival
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1164750/ss_59036c442f96c58bc3106fe1fd007e66f5a2786d.600x338.jpg?t=1595005106[/img]

[b]Chainsaw Film and Game Festival 2020[/b]

My VR Experience has been selected to be part of the Official Selection of 2020 for the Chainsaw Film and Game Festival.

Official Selection nominees will compete in every category including – Best Film, Best Director and Best Game.

Award winners will be announced on August, 15th 2020.

Like and Subscribe for updates.

Cheers David
